title: 序章23 音乐会序章24 劣势
content_zh:
象征着白天的金色光片，横跨整片天空，缓缓从东方升起，扫过蓝天白云。
天色愈发明亮，黎木缓缓从马车上走了下来。
罕见的直面白天的光芒，不免让黎木感到有些刺眼。
模糊间，远处，熟悉的监狱轮廓渐渐显现。
不过这次的目的地却不是黑蔷薇监狱，而是它隔壁三条街的奥古莱斯剧院。
奥古莱斯剧院是边境的门面，耗材不菲。
哪怕隔着一段距离，也能感受到其如巨兽一般匍匐在大地之上的厚重感。
所有直视剧院的人无不震惊。
黎木同样略显惊讶。
明明街道里的房屋那样简陋矮小，却没想到马尔提雅竟然也有大型建筑。
不过也仅仅只是略微的惊讶了一下，便没了感觉。
虽说剧院也算是大型建筑，可比起前世那些大机场、体育馆之类的，还是显得太过落后了。
至少，黎木的认知中，在存在魔法的世界里，修这么大的房子并没什么了不起的。
思考中，脚下却没有停下。
没过多久，黎木跟在玛丽伯爵的队伍后面，便也抵达了剧院门口。
一进入剧院大厅，立刻有专门的人员，牵引着参赛的奴隶们与贵族分流。
黎木这一队一共26人，其中确定参赛的共6人，都是专业乐师隐藏身份而来。
剩下的20人虽然都带着乐器，其实只是面容较好的奴隶，充门面来的，并不如何精通乐理，黎木也在其中。
“哦~瞧瞧，这是哪来的乡巴佬？看衣服，难道是多罗文斯家那位的奴隶？”
临近的队伍中，为首的一名“贵奴”

调侃的说道。
这种一看就不是奴隶之流，多半也是找的乐师、商贾、冒险者之类，甚至低级贵族冒充的。
不过黎木倒是不在意他们的嘴脸，自顾自的打量着环境。
似乎是黎木所在的队伍表现得太安静了，没能让嘲讽者得到应有的反馈，变本加厉起来，语气也更加挑逗。
“哦吼，这是破罐子破摔了嘛？看看，这些奴隶哪有精通乐理的样子，怕不是一群劣奴过来充数的吧？不会吧，玛丽家连培养奴隶的资产都没了？”
“怎么会？你看看那前头几个人，满手的四乐茧，说不准是哪家出来的学徒呢~”
周遭又有人附和道。
一而再，再而三。
黎木藏在队伍中撇了撇嘴，暗暗惊讶于玛丽家的情况。
明明贵为伯爵，现实中却被如此明目张胆的针对。
究竟是玛丽这个人特殊，还是说派系争斗已经凌驾于实际爵位之上了？
就在黎木思绪万千的时候，队伍中，为首的男子似乎因为提及师门，终于皱了皱眉头开口道：“哼，四乐茧倒是常见，可自诩大家的三指茧却不多见，也不知道赫赫有名的大家何必跑来奴隶堆中找存在。”
隔壁队伍的人折辱不成，反被戳中痛点，顿时急眼了：“小子！
这里虽然不让动手，但也没说外面就好混了！”
眼看氛围变化，周围有更多队伍好奇的看过来，其中不乏内陆贵族家的。
为避免有心人利用，双方便在尴尬的氛围中不欢而散。
众人抵达了自己房间，很快便有侍女端送食物而来。
这一次就明显不同了，麦粥、面包，甚至有一小碟盐，那些奴隶各个宛如饿死鬼投胎，呼哧呼哧比起母猪炫食也不遑多让。
而另一边的6人就显得正常不少，只是同样吃的很快。
现在这情况，愿意帮玛丽的乐师不多了，他们的情况自然也不会太好。

就这样，安静中伴着激烈的吃食声，时间一点点过去了。
“走了，入场。”
content_en:
The golden light symbolizing daytime spans the entire sky, rising slowly from the east and sweeping across the blue sky and white clouds.
The sky became brighter and brighter, and Li Mu slowly got off the carriage.
It was rare to face the light of day, which made Li Mu feel a little dazzling.
In the blur, in the distance, the familiar outline of the prison gradually appeared.
But this time the destination was not Black Rose Prison, but the Augules Theater three streets next to it.
The Augules Theater was the frontier's face, and its supplies were expensive.
Even from a distance, you can feel the heaviness of it crawling on the ground like a giant beast.
Everyone who looked directly into the theater was shocked.
Li Mu was also slightly surprised.
Although the houses in the street were so simple and short, I didn't expect that there were large buildings in Martiya.
However, I was only slightly surprised, and then I felt nothing.
Although the theater can be considered a large building, it still seems too backward compared to the large airports and stadiums in previous lives.
At least, according to Li Mu's perception, in a world where magic exists, building such a big house is not a big deal.
While thinking, my feet did not stop.
Not long after, Li Mu followed Earl Mary's team and arrived at the entrance of the theater.
As soon as they entered the theater hall, there were special personnel immediately leading the slaves participating in the competition to separate them from the nobles.
Li Mu's team has a total of 26 people, of which 6 people are confirmed to participate. They are all professional musicians who came to hide their identities.
Although the remaining 20 people all brought musical instruments, they were actually just slaves with good looks. They came just for appearance and were not very proficient in music theory. Li Mu was among them.
"Oh~ look, where does this country bumpkin come from? Look at his clothes, could he be the slave of the Dorovens family?"
In the approaching team, the leader is a "noble slave"
Said teasingly.
At first glance, these people are not slaves. They are probably musicians, merchants, adventurers, or even low-level nobles.
However, Li Mu didn't care about their faces and just kept looking at the environment.
It seems that Li Mu's team was too quiet and failed to let the mockers get the feedback they deserve. They became more aggressive and their tone became more provocative.
"Oh, is this a broken pot? Look, these slaves don't look like they are proficient in music theory. Isn't it a group of bad slaves who came here to make up for their income? No way, Mary's family doesn't even have the assets to train slaves?"
"How could it be? Look at the first few people, their hands are full of cocoons of music. You can't tell which apprentice they are from~"
Others around him echoed.
Again and again.
Li Mu Zang curled his lips in the team, secretly surprised by the situation of Mary's family.
He is obviously a count, but in reality he is being targeted so blatantly.
Is it because Mary is a special person, or is it that factional fighting has taken precedence over the actual title?
Just when Li Mu was thinking a lot, the man at the head of the team frowned and said, seemingly because of the mention of his master's sect, "Huh, four-fingered cocoons are common, but three-fingered cocoons that claim to be ours are rare, and I don't know why the famous people would come to the slave pile to find their existence."
The people in the team next door couldn't bear the humiliation, but they were hit hard, and they suddenly became anxious: "Boy!
Although you are not allowed to do anything here, it doesn't mean that you can just mess around outside! "
Seeing the change in the atmosphere, more teams around them looked over curiously, including many from inland noble families.
In order to avoid being taken advantage of by interested parties, both parties broke up in an awkward atmosphere.
Everyone arrived in their rooms, and soon a maid came with food.
This time it was obviously different. There were wheat porridge, bread, and even a small dish of salt. The slaves were like reincarnations of starving ghosts, huffing and puffing as much as the sows showing off their food.
The 6 people on the other side seemed quite normal, but they also ate very quickly.
In this situation, there are not many musicians willing to help Mary., their situation will naturally not be too good.
In this way, time passed little by little in silence accompanied by the intense sound of eating.
"Let's go, come in."
